summary: Ran comprehensive backend pytest suite (41 tests across public, auth+must_change, register, profile, marshal, driver, owner, admin, SOS) plus Playwright UI smoke tests on Landing, SignIn role grid, wrong-credential toast, admin/driver/owner dashboards, and PublicShare. All 41 backend tests PASSED (100%). All UI flows loaded correctly and integrated with the backend. Seeded PINs were permanently changed for the accounts listed under test_credentials — later agents MUST use those new secrets.

minor.issue: When a marshal/driver sends an email in body it is silently ignored (no 400). Not a bug per spec, but consider surfacing a warning or 400 for clarity.
N+1 query pattern: iterates routes and issues a taxis.find per route. Fine for seed size but flag for scale.

On every startup seed forcibly re-sets must_change=true via $set for admin/owner/marshal/driver users. Existing users who already changed their PIN get must_change flipped back to True on backend restart, forcing another PIN change (secret_hash is preserved via _upsert_user so the new PIN still works).
Uses 20m fixed threshold; not per-rank configurable. Product-level note only.

issues: 'Signed in' toast overlaps the top-right user chip briefly on all dashboards (visible in screenshots). Minor z-index / positioning polish.

action_items: None blocking. Consider not resetting must_change on every seed startup (guard with $setOnInsert) so PIN-changed users are not re-prompted after a backend restart.
Optional: return 400 (or a warning field) when a marshal/driver attempts to update email via /profile instead of silently dropping it.
critical_code_review_comments: seed._upsert_user hashes the secret only on insert, but the $set path still re-writes must_change=True on every startup — this partially defeats the change-secret flow after a backend restart.
server.py is ~750 lines and mixes all routers; consider splitting per-role router modules for maintainability.
No rate limiting or brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login — playbook mentions 5-fail lockout expectation; not implemented.

CORS uses allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True which browsers reject for credentialed requests (works here because JWT is sent via Authorization header, not cookies, but the combination is misconfigured).

success_rate.frontend: 100% smoke (Landing, SignIn, Admin, Driver, Owner dashboards, PublicShare all loaded and rendered correct data)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests are idempotent — _login_any() tries both original and updated secret so the suite runs cleanly on re-execution. Marshal Lesedi Morata was also PIN-changed to 900900900 to enable the driver wrong-rank test. If seed_module.seed() is modified to guard must_change with $setOnInsert, remove the old-secret fallback path.
rca of the issue: No blocking issues observed. Note on seed: because seed() runs on every startup and $sets must_change=True for admin/owner/marshal/driver, after each backend restart the affected users will be re-prompted to change PIN on next login — mitigation: move must_change into $setOnInsert only.
